name: Volumetric Path Tracing with BSSRDF and Medium Sampling
aliases: Path Tracing with Subsurface Scattering and Participating Media
Subsurface Scattering Integration in Volumetric Path Tracing
summary: This method extends volumetric path tracing by integrating BSSRDF probes into the path loop to simulate subsurface scattering, distinguishing itself from standard volume tracing by treating subsurface exits as surface interactions.
